LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.3
https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0)

Files bundled here:
  LibreHardwareMonitorLib.dll  (0.9.3, net472 build)
  HidSharp.dll                 (2.6.4, netstandard2.0 build)

These libraries are used unmodified to read GPU / CPU sensors
(temperature, power, clocks, fan speeds) on hardware where the
vendor does not provide a command line tool - AMD GPUs in particular,
where nvidia-smi has no equivalent.

Source for both packages: https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/0.9.3
                          https://www.nuget.org/packages/HidSharp/2.6.4

GameCrashDiag itself is licensed under MIT; this directory is MPL-2.0.
